operation.description: Deterministic exact rational enclosure of one sparse scalar QQ polynomial on a complete axis-aligned box. It contains the full image, need not be the exact range, and containing zero does not prove a root. Bounds: 4,096 terms; degree 32768 per variable and 262144 total; 32768-digit coefficient and 32768-digit input-endpoint components; 32,768 term-axis pairs; 65,536-digit intermediate components; 32,768-digit result components; 10,485,760-byte canonical retained-source result.

examples.description: Enclose x^2 + y + 1 on [1,2] x [0,1]; the box must use the polynomial's complete ordered (x, y) axis.
examples.name: positive_bivariate_box

input_schema.description: Enclose one canonical scalar QQ polynomial on a complete closed rational box. The box must use exactly the polynomial's ordered variables. The returned exact rational interval is deterministic and sound but need not be the exact range. Bounds: 4,096 terms; degree 32768 per variable and 262144 total; 32768-digit coefficient and 32768-digit input-endpoint components; 32,768 term-axis pairs; 65,536-digit intermediate components; 32,768-digit result components; 10,485,760-byte canonical retained-source result.
